famous.name: Well known (30 or more Wikipedia editions)

no_reflag.name: Leaving out the pre-1582 dates whose flag I corrected

post1582.name: Only dates after the Gregorian reform (from 15 October 1582)

with_uncertain.name: Adding the uncertain British Old Style dates and the ancient dates

no_day1.name: Leaving out dates on the 1st of a month (possible month-only dates)

own_point.name: Only battles with their own coordinates

one_per_day.name: One battle per date (sub-battles of the same day counted once)

famous.label: Battle of Halys
famous.record: Herodotus: a total eclipse of the Sun stopped the battle (28 May 585 BC, Julian), so a new Moon

famous.record: a lunar eclipse eleven days before (20 September 331 BC, Julian)

famous.name: Pydna, 168 BC
famous.label: Battle of Pydna
famous.record: Livy: a lunar eclipse the night before (21 June 168 BC, Julian), so a full Moon

famous.name: Badr, 624
famous.label: Battle of Badr
famous.record: 17 Ramadan in the Islamic lunar calendar, whose months begin at the new crescent

famous.name: Isandlwana, 1879
famous.label: Battle of Isandlwana

famous.name: Second El Alamein, 1942
famous.label: Second Battle of El Alamein
famous.record: the night attack opened under a Moon just short of full

famous.name: D-Day, 1944
famous.label: Normandy landings
famous.record: the date was set for a bright Moon near full, for the airborne drops, and a low but rising tide soon after dawn
